answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. A whisper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the vault of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
